name: Memori
summary: Open-source, LLM- and datastore-agnostic memory layer for agents from Memori Labs: Python/TypeScript SDKs that wrap your LLM client, bring-your-own DB or Memori Cloud, plus MCP.
description: Register an LLM client (e.g. OpenAI) with the SDK and conversations are persisted and recalled automatically, attributed to an entity and process. Self-host free under Apache-2.0 with your own database (BYODB), or use Memori Cloud: a free tier (5,000 memories created and 15,000 recalled) and production plans from $60K/year. Coding agents can connect without the SDK through the remote MCP server at `https://api.memorilabs.ai/mcp/` using `X-Memori-API-Key`, entity and process headers.

agent_access.notes: Send X-Memori-API-Key, X-Memori-Entity-Id and X-Memori-Process-Id headers.
